title: Eleventy Theme Framework theme.json
description: Schema for the theme.json file in the Eleventy Theme Framework.

contractVersion.description: Template-contract version this theme targets (framework ↔ theme API). Core refuses themes outside its supported range. A theme MUST provide the required layouts (currently 'base.njk') for the contract it declares.

capabilities.description: What this theme implements, so the framework can warn (not crash) when a site asks for something unsupported.

socialPlatforms.description: Optional theme extensions to the framework's canonical platform→URL templates. Themes should not redeclare the built-in platforms.

layouts.description: A list of layout files provided by the theme, used for aliasing.

themeFeatures.description: A list of self-contained JavaScript features provided by the theme.

build.description: Build-time configuration hints for optimization plugins.

safelist.description: PurgeCSS safelist patterns to preserve. Strings are converted to RegExp at build time.

assets.description: Theme asset entry points for styles and scripts.

entry.description: Path to the main stylesheet entry point (relative to theme root).
Path to the main JavaScript entry point (relative to theme root).

config.description: Theme configuration options. Users override via theme.config.mjs.

codeHighlighting.description: Code highlighting configuration (PrismJS theme and diff support).

diffHighlight.description: Include PrismJS diff-highlight plugin CSS for added/removed line highlighting.

passthroughCopy.description: Configuration for files to be passed through Eleventy's copy mechanism.
